title: Prune crosslink rules to repo stack + refresh Python(conda)/JS+TS(eval-contexts) guidance

comments.author: claude
comments.content: Done. (1) Removed 17 absent-language/framework rule guides (c/cpp/csharp/elixir/elixir-phoenix/go/java/javascript-react/kotlin/odin/php/ruby/rust/scala/swift/typescript-react/zig); kept python/javascript/typescript/shell + non-language guides (global/project/quality/rigor/knowledge/web/tracking-*/sanitize-patterns). Kept web.md (hostile-content security — core to a crawler). (2) python.md rewritten for the conda reality: env 'openwpm' via 'conda run -n openwpm', never mutate the env, don't hand-edit environment.yaml (use scripts/repin.sh), black+isort+mypy via pre-commit, pytest markers (pyonly/slow), subprocess/DB boundary, schema-sync note, the OpenWPMJSTest value-capture idiom. (3) javascript.md + typescript.md gained an 'execution contexts' section: extension world (moz-extension, browser.*) vs page-world injected legacy instrument (stringified getInstrumentJS, no browser.*, everything page-observable) vs stealth content-script (exportFunction/Xray); rules for self-contained stringified code, webpack name-mangling, cross-realm cloneInto/exportFunction/Xray, page-as-adversarial footprint minimization. Trimmed the web-app-server assumptions that don't fit an extension (zod API boundaries, CSP headers, DOMPurify) and pointed the toolchain at Extension/ npm run build/lint/fix.
